speaker: CALLER
text: Good afternoon, I am calling from your bank's fraud monitoring team regarding a transaction on your card ending 4471.

speaker: CALLER
text: We flagged a transaction of eighteen thousand rupees at an online merchant this morning. Can you confirm whether this was you?

speaker: CALLER
text: Thank you. I have blocked the card as a precaution. You will not be liable for that transaction.

speaker: VICTIM
text: How do I know this call is genuine?

speaker: CALLER
text: That is a very fair question. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password, and I will not ask you for any code. If you prefer, please hang up and call us back on the number on your card. You can also visit your nearest branch. Your reference number for this call is 8829104.

speaker: CALLER
text: Take your time, and you can discuss with your family before doing anything. A replacement card will reach you in five working days.
